text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — final planning for the benchmark newsletter + webinar. I want to 1) nail segmentation and behavioral triggers, 2) lock A/B subject + preview, 3) detail the nurture for low-engagers, and 4) confirm HubSpot routing. Who can own send and QA? :email:

Evan (Growth): I can run the send and measurement. Proposed audiences (behavior-first):
- devs: api_active_7d AND last_api_call < 3d
- trials_warm: trial_start_14d AND product_open_rate >= 30%
- churned_eval: last_api_call > 60d AND created_at < 120d
Also we should create an "influencers" microsegment for users with public OSS projects in company profile.

Priya (Demand Gen): Subject / preview candidates (A/B/C):
A) "New inference benchmark + live walkthrough — register"
B) "How teams cut inference cost 30% — benchmarks inside"
C) "Benchmark: real latency numbers + a live Q&A"
Preview ideas: "Wed 30m demo + benchmark deck" / "Download the PDF — read in 3 mins"

Jules (Content): Content variants to produce:
- Dev: single-line code snippet, inline perf sparkline, CTA: "See perf"
- Trials_warm: short product highlight + 1-click demo, CTA: "Start demo"
- Churned_eval: reminder + highlight what's changed (new quantization + routing), CTA: "Read the brief"
I'll make a variant that swaps the hero image to a compact chart for mobile.

Tom (Sales Ops): HubSpot routing rules I'll implement:
- webinar signups -> add tag "benchmark_may_2026" and enroll in workflow "webinar_followup_may_2026"
- If company_size >= 100 AND intent_score >= 65 -> create AE task (owner: enterprise_queue)
- Trials_warm with product_open_rate >= 30% AND last_api_call <= 7d -> assign to SDR queue "trial_warm_inbound"
- Churned_eval who click PDF link -> enroll in "churned_reengage_drip" (3 emails over 14 days)
Smart list snippet to copy to HS: ```Contact property: company_size >= 100 AND contact property: session_count_30d > 2```

Maya (Marketing): Send cadence proposal: main send Tue 11am PT, 48h reminder to non-openers (different subject), 7-day follow-up with webinar recording to openers who didn't register. For churned_eval, start a re-engagement drip with 3 emails over two weeks.

Asha (Head of Marketing): A few asks: 1) Legal sign-off on any % claims before send, 2) keep 2% randomized holdout for attribution, 3) ensure unsubscribe/path to preferences is clear for re-engagement flows.

Evan (Growth): I'll own QA with Priya. Tracking plan: use utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=benchmark_may_2026&utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Also embedding a concise post-send survey in the follow-up to non-registrants (single radio question). ETA for QA doc: Mon 6pm PT. I'll set up an experiment: randomize subject variants across segments with stratified sampling (5k per cell min).

Priya (Demand Gen): Nurture detail: low-open cohort -> subject rework + 48h resend, then 7-day value-add email (short playbook), then 14-day final CTA with customer quote. Churned_eval drip: 3 emails (what changed, quick benchmark highlights, short product invite). Will draft content and share doc link.

Jules (Content): I'll upload three microcopy sets and a one-paragraph customer quote (permission granted) to the marketing assets. Also creating alt text and a smaller chart-only image for inbox preview.

Tom (Sales Ops): I'll build the workflows and include the assignment matrix (mapping intent_score buckets -> SDR/AE queues). Will post screenshots and exact enrollment filters here when complete.

Campaign Scheduler Bot: Campaign "benchmark_may_2026" created and scheduled for Tue 11:00 PT (campaign_id: 334455).

Evan (Growth): Note on measurement: include both open-to-register and click-to-register metrics; holdout will let us estimate incremental uplift. Also propose a secondary metric: trial activation within 14 days for trial_warm cohort.

Maya (Marketing): Action items recap: Evan = QA + send + measurement; Priya = nurture flows + subject variants; Jules = copy + assets; Tom = HubSpot workflows + routing matrix; Asha = legal review. Please drop final subject lines and snapshot of legal-approved claim by Mon EOD.

Maya (Marketing): Microcopy suggestions: dev CTA: "See perf", trials CTA: "Start 1-click demo", churned CTA: "Read what's new". Use concise alt text for charts.

Evan (Growth): I'll tag legal in the QA doc once subjects are in. Also adding a short survey to follow-up to understand "why not register" options: "timing", "not relevant", "already using".

Tom (Sales Ops): Workflow "webinar_followup_may_2026" created (ID: 334498) and routing matrix uploaded to /marketing/workflows. Posting screenshots in 10m.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — will close once legal thumbs up and QA checklist green. :pray:
